segments.an5.168:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an5.168:1.3: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ;
segments.an5.168:1.4: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo;
segments.an5.168:1.5: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an5.168:1.7: Tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi … pe … pheggupi … sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an5.168:1.8: Evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi;
segments.an5.168:1.9: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ;
segments.an5.168:1.10: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo;
segments.an5.168:1.11: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an5.168:2.2: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ;
segments.an5.168:2.3: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo;
segments.an5.168:2.4: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an5.168:2.5: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, rukkho, sākhāpalāsasampanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi … pe … pheggupi … sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an5.168:2.6: Evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi;
segments.an5.168:2.7: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ;
segments.an5.168:2.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo;
segments.an5.168:2.9: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanan”ti [a. ni.5.168;6.50;7.65].

lines: 167-9. Sattame vatthusandassanāti yasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ āpatti, tassa sarūpato dassanaṃ.
Āpattisandassanāti yaṃ āpattiṃ so āpanno, tassā dassanaṃ.
Ayasaṃ āropetīti “ime maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhantā ayasaṃ byasanaṃ uppādentī”ti bhikkhūnaṃ ayasaṃ uppādeti.
